name: TC-SL-004 — 添加风格店弹窗与校验 [P0]
description: 验证添加风格店弹窗：Seller ID必填且纯数字且不可重复，负责买手必选且可搜索下拉

steps.expression: (() => { const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('添加风格店')); if (btn) { btn.click(); return { clicked: true, disabled: btn.disabled }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal, .ant-drawer, [class*=modal]'); if (!modal) return { found: false }; const title = modal.querySelector('.ant-modal-title, h3, h4')?.textContent.trim(); const sellerInput = modal.querySelector('input[placeholder*=Seller], input[id*=seller], input'); const buyerSelect = modal.querySelector('.ant-select'); const cancelBtn = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('取消')); const saveBtn = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('保存')); return { found: true, title, sellerInput: !!sellerInput, buyerSelect: !!buyerSelect, cancelBtn: !!cancelBtn, saveBtn: !!saveBtn }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal, .ant-drawer, [class*=modal]'); if (!modal) return { clicked: false, reason: 'modal not found' }; const saveBtn = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('保存') || b.textContent.includes('确定') || b.textContent.includes('提交')); if (saveBtn) { saveBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false, reason: 'save button not found' }; })()
steps.description: 空表单直接点保存，触发校验

steps.expression: (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal, .ant-drawer, [class*=modal]'); if (!modal) return { stillOpen: false, errors: [], reason: 'modal not found' }; const errors = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item-explain-error, .ant-form-item-explain, [class*=error]')).map(e => e.textContent.trim()); const stillOpen = !!modal; return { stillOpen, errors }; })()
steps.description: 验证空表单校验错误提示
校验失败时弹窗不关闭

_testDesign.preconditions: 用户有添加风格店权限（管理员/产运/Leader）
_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 点击添加风格店按钮
2. 验证弹窗包含Seller ID输入框和负责买手选择器
3. 空表单直接点保存
4. 验证校验错误提示
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. 弹窗展示Seller ID输入框（必填、纯数字、不可重复）和负责买手可搜索下拉（必选）
2. 空表单保存时校验失败，展示错误提示
3. 弹窗保持打开不关闭
4. 取消/关闭弹窗/点击蒙层不保存
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/店铺列表
